newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania's leu flat, bond yield seen at 60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania's leu flat, bond yield seen at 60 pct.

text.p: 1255 GMT - Romania's leu ended Tuesday loittering at 7,420/500 to the dollar, stable on its opening quotes, on a quiet interbank market, dealers said.
* Operators said the dollar demand had been low, with the market focusing on an auction for 371-day bonds.
Some said the finance ministry's offer of 1.132 trillion lei in one-year bonds had been oversubscribed with the yield at 60 percent. Auction results have yet to be released officially.
* Dealers said the leu was likely to cling to present levels throughout the week, with the central bank keeping an eye on the market to prevent large swings in exchange rates.

* One-week prices closed slightly higher near 43 percent against 42 percent at opening, as banks were chasing leu funds to meet reserve requirements. Overnight rates bounched back to 37 percent from peaks of 38-39 percent at midday, but remained higher than 34 percent in early trading.
* Leu-dollar retail prices eased slightly to about 7,420/500 from 7,400/500 in early trading.
